procedures.usage:
program bounded_minimum
  use kind_module, only: wp
  use bobyqa_module, only: bobyqa
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n=2, npt=5
  real(wp) :: x(n), xl(n), xu(n), f
  x=[0.5_wp,0.5_wp]
  xl=[0.0_wp,0.0_wp]
  xu=[1.0_wp,1.0_wp]
  call bobyqa(n,npt,x,xl,xu,0.2_wp,1.0e-8_wp,0,1000,objective)
  call objective(n,x,f)
  print *, x, f
contains
  subroutine objective(n,x,f)
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
    real(wp), intent(out) :: f
    f=(x(1)-2.0_wp)**2+(x(2)+1.0_wp)**2
  end subroutine objective
end program bounded_minimum

procedures.summary: Declare TYPE(tpca) :: solver from forpca. One-call PCA interface: rows of MATRIX are observations, columns variables; use at least two rows, at least two columns and 1<=NPC<=number of columns. Match KINDS::RK from the dependency. COEFF is a required allocatable output after optional NPC/METHOD, so use COEFF=... and METHOD=... keywords. Prefer METHOD="eig" for covariance eigenvalues: the default "svd" branch instead squares covariance singular values and divides by NCOL-1, which is not the usual PCA variance convention. SCORE is allocated with NCOL columns but only the first NPC are filled. EXPLAINED is percent normalized by the first NPC eigenvalues, not automatically total variance. MATRIX_APP uses inconsistent centering in this pin; omit it when relying on this interface. No status output is provided. Use a fresh TPCA object for each fit. The passed object THIS is implicit in solver%; do not pass it again. Optional actuals shown in brackets can be supplied by keyword.

Declare TYPE(tpca) :: solver from forpca. Release several internal arrays through the public FINALIZE binding. This is not a complete reusable-object reset in the pinned source: LATENT and EXPLAINED_VARIANCE remain allocated. Calling PCA again after this binding alone can therefore fail on allocation. procedures.summary: Jenkins-Traub roots of a real polynomial. Supply DEGREE>=1, real OP(DEGREE+1) in descending-power order with nonzero leading coefficient, and real output ZEROR/ZEROI(DEGREE). The REAL128 branch ERROR STOPs because no quad LAPACK solver is provided; matching real32/real64 LAPACK must be linked. Root order is not specified, and small eigenvalue residuals are not certified here.

Complex-coefficient companion-matrix roots through LAPACK CGEEV/ZGEEV. N>=1, COMPLEX(kind=POLYROOTS_MODULE_RK) P(N+1) in descending-power order and W(N) output. INFO=0 converged, -999 zero leading coefficient; other diagnostics come from LAPACK. REAL128 ERROR STOPs; real32/real64 requires matching LAPACK. Work arrays are internal. Results are unsorted and should be checked by residuals, particularly for ill-conditioned/multiple roots.
